facts.text: Sarah, I am not your friend. Fine, I am. Just be careful what you put in your mouth, and do not take the peach.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Hoggle's words and it gets the plot backwards. Jareth orders Hoggle to give Sarah the enchanted peach. Hoggle tries to get rid of it, is stopped, then hands it over and runs off in shame. He never warns her off it. The funtrivia quote list shows his real lines, such as being a coward and Jareth scaring him.
facts.fix: Sarah, I'm sorry about the peach. Jareth scares me, and I'm a coward. Eat your stew.
